name: Lubrificanus
source:
The Kingdom of Perineam has endured the terrible reign of the Tight King for 100 years ! This abominable monarch has imposed a law prohibiting the use of lube in all lovemaking taking place on its territory.

You play as the Lube Fairy who, accompanied by a knight with welcoming buttocks, will set off on an adventure to get rid of this terrible law.

BRING LUBE BACK TO PERINEAM !

[From [url=https://uramakigigan.itch.io/lubrificanus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Perineam王国在紧缩王可怕的统治下苦苦挣扎了整整100年！这位令人作呕的君主颁布了一条法律，禁止在其领土内发生的任何性爱行为中使用润滑剂。

你将扮演润滑剂精灵，与一位臀部十分热情的骑士结伴踏上冒险之旅，设法废除这条恶法。

让润滑剂重返Perineam！

[来源：[url=https://uramakigigan.itch.io/lubrificanus]Itch.io[/url]]
